Rashi on Berakhot 5a:10:1.hebrew: יסורין של אהבה - הקב"ה מייסרו בעוה"ז בלא שום עון, כדי להרבות שכרו בעולם הבא יותר מכדי זכיותיו:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:10:1.english: Afflictions of love - The Holy One, Blessed be He, afflicts him in this world without any sin, in order to increase his reward in the World-to-Come beyond the measure of his merits.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:11:1.hebrew: וה' חפץ דכאו החלי - מי שהקב"ה חפץ בו, מחלהו ביסורין:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:11:1.english: Yet the Lord desired to crush him, He made him ill - One in whom the Holy One, Blessed be He, delights, He makes him ill with suffering.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:12:2.english: His will - Of his own volition.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:17:1.hebrew: דבר זה - שאשרי אדם אשר תיסרנו יה:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:17:1.english: This matter - That "Happy is the person whom You afflict, Lord."

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:17:2.hebrew: מתורתך תלמדנו - כלומר, מתורתך אנו למדין אותו:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:17:2.english: From Your Torah You teach us - That is to say, from Your Torah we learn it.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:19:1.hebrew: נאמר ברית ביסורין דכתיב אלה דברי הברית - אחר הקללות נאמר במשנה תורה:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:19:1.english: "Covenant" is stated with regard to afflictions, as it is written: "These are the words of the covenant" - [This verse] is stated after the curses in Deuteronomy.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:19:2.hebrew: אף יסורין ממרקין כל עונותיו של אדם - גרסי':
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:19:2.english: So too, suffering cleanses all of a person's transgressions - This is our reading.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:1:1.hebrew: ואם תלמיד חכם הוא - שרגיל במשנתו לחזור על גרסתו תמיד, דיו בכך:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:1:1.english: And if he is a Torah scholar - Since he is accustomed in his study to constantly review his learning, this is sufficient for him.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:23:1.hebrew: ודרך חיים - חיי העוה"ב הויין לו תוכחות מוסר לאדם:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:23:1.english: And the way of life - The life of the World-to-Come is [attained] for a person through reproofs of instruction.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:2:1.hebrew: ירגיז יצר טוב - שיעשה מלחמה עם יצר הרע:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:2:1.english: One should incite the good inclination - That he should wage war against the evil inclination.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:2:2.hebrew: ודומו סלה - יום הדומיה הוא יום המות, שהוא דומיה עולמית:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:2:2.english: And be silent, Selah - The day of silence is the day of death, which is an eternal silence.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:3:1.hebrew: זה מקרא - חומש, שמצוה לקרות בתורה:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:3:1.english: This is Scripture - The Pentateuch, which it is a mitzvah to read from the Torah.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:3:2.english: This is the Mishna - That they should occupy themselves with the Mishna.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:3:3.hebrew: זה גמרא - סברת טעמי המשניות, שממנו יוצאה הוראה. אבל המורים הוראה מן המשנה נקראו מבלי העולם במס' סוטה (דף כב.):
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:3:3.english: This is Gemara - The reasoning behind the rationales of the mishnayot, from which halakhic ruling issues. However, those who issue halakhic rulings from the Mishna are called "destroyers of the world" in Tractate Sotah (page 22a).

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:4:1.hebrew: כאלו אוחז חרב של שתי פיות בידו - להרוג את המזיקין:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:4:1.english: As if he holds a double-edged sword in his hand - To kill the demons.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:4:2.english: From where is it inferred - That [it refers to] the recitation of the Shema.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:5:1.hebrew: ובני רשף יגביהו עוף - העוף מסלקם ממך:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:5:1.english: And the sparks fly upward - The "flight" [i.e., Torah] removes them from you.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:5:2.hebrew: התעיף עיניך בו - אם תכפל וסגרת עיניך בתורה, היא משתכחת ממך:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:5:2.english: Will you close your eyes to it - If you fold [your eyelids] and close your eyes to the Torah, it will be forgotten by you.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:5:3.hebrew: קטב מרירי - זה שם שד הצהרים במסכת פסחים (דף קיא:):
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:5:3.english: Bitter destruction - This is the name of the noontime demon in Tractate Pesachim (page 111b).

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:6:1.hebrew: ולחומי רשף - כתיב בין רעב למזיקין, נדרש לפניו ולאחריו: יסורין ומזיקין:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:6:1.english: And devoured by sparks - It is written between hunger and demons, [so] it is expounded [according to what is] before it and after it: afflictions and demons.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:7:1.hebrew: אפילו תינוקות של בית רבן יודעים - שהתורה מגינה, שלמדין מספר חומש: אם שמוע תשמע כל המחלה אשר שמתי וגו'. ואפילו הקטנים, שלא הגיעו לספר איוב, כבר למדו:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:7:1.english: Even schoolchildren know - That the Torah protects, as they learn from the Book of the Pentateuch: "If you will diligently listen... all the disease that I have placed, etc." And even the young children, who have not yet reached the Book of Job, have already learned [this].

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:7:2.english: I was silent from good - From the Torah.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:7:3.english: And my pain was troubled - A distressing affliction.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:8:1.hebrew: המוכר עצב - שפירש הימנו דבר חשוב כזה, ומתוך דוחקו מכרו:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:8:1.english: The seller is sad - Because such an important item has departed from him, and he sold it out of his distress.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:8:2.hebrew: ושמח - שהרי הקב"ה מזהירם מלעזוב אותה, ומשבחה לפניהם בלקח טוב אחר שנתנה להם:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:8:2.english: And He rejoiced - For the Holy One, Blessed be He, warns them against abandoning it, and praises it before them as "a good acquisition" after He gave it to them.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:9:1.hebrew: פשפש ולא מצא - לא מצא עבירה בידו, שבשבילה ראוין יסורין הללו לבא:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:9:1.english: He examined and did not find - He did not find a transgression in his hand for which these afflictions are fitting to come.

Rashi on Berakhot 5a:9:2.hebrew: אשרי הגבר אשר תיסרנו יה ומתורתך תלמדנו - שבשביל יסורין צריך אדם לבא לידי תלמוד תורה:
Rashi on Berakhot 5a:9:2.english: Happy is the man whom You chasten, Lord, and teach him from Your Torah - That on account of suffering, a person must come to Torah study.
